prose: Reuters reports, citing sources, that Flock Safety plans to lay off about 270 employees, 18% of its staff, at the end of October, after a voluntary buyout program in September. The AI surveillance startup has faced public backlash. The article was not accessible, so details come from the excerpt.
highlights: Flock Safety to cut about 270 jobs, 18% of staff
Layoffs due at end of October
Follows a voluntary buyout in September
Comes amid backlash against its surveillance products
